items.name: Laurent M.
items.text: Incredible! I installed the screen in 3 minutes on my BMW E90. Sound goes through my car's Bluetooth, it's perfect. Wireless CarPlay, nothing to complain about.

items.name: Sophie D.
items.text: I was hesitant because of the price, but honestly it's the best car purchase I've made. The screen is beautiful and Waze runs great.

items.text: Delivery received in 48h as promised. Installation is truly plug & play. My old Clio now has CarPlay, I'm amazed.

items.text: I got the motorcycle version for my Yamaha MT-07. Waterproof, solid and GPS works perfectly even in full sun. Top!

items.name: Émilie V.

items.name: Nicolas P.

items.name: Amina K.

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know before ordering

items.q: Is it compatible with my iPhone 15 / 16?
items.a: Yes! OxaPlay is compatible with all iPhones from iPhone 6 and above, including iPhone 15 and 16. Connection is wireless via Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.

items.q: How does the sound come out of the car speakers?
items.a: Sound is transmitted via FM connection, Bluetooth or AUX (3.5mm jack cable included). You can choose the method that best suits your vehicle.
Absolutely. Simply plug the screen into your car's cigarette lighter, enable Bluetooth on your phone, and you're ready. No tools, no complex wiring. Installation in under 5 minutes.

items.q: Can I return it if I don't like it?
items.a: Of course. You have a 14-day return period. If the product doesn't suit you, contact us at support@oxaplay.com and we'll arrange the return and full refund.

items.q: Does it work with Android too?
items.a: Yes, OxaPlay is compatible with Android Auto as well as Apple CarPlay. All recent Android smartphones (Android 10+) are supported.
